# Laravel Disposable Email (erag/laravel-disposable-email)

> High-performance Laravel package to block disposable, temporary, and fake burner email addresses with offline validation, 124,000+ local domains, custom blocklists, automated domain syncing, and optional RFC/DNS checks.

## Core Information
- **Package**: `erag/laravel-disposable-email`
- **Documentation**: https://erag.in/laravel-disposable-email/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/eramitgupta/laravel-disposable-email
- **Packagist**: https://packagist.org/packages/erag/laravel-disposable-email
- **Author**: Er Amit Gupta (https://erag.in/)
- **License**: MIT
- **Requirements**: PHP 8.1+, Laravel 10.x, 11.x, 12.x+
- **Keywords**: laravel, email-validation, disposable-email, fake-email, spam-protection, rfc5322, mx-check

## Installation
```bash
composer require erag/laravel-disposable-email
```

Publish configuration & install:
```bash
php artisan erag:install-disposable-email
```

Sync latest domain list:
```bash
php artisan erag:sync-disposable-email-list
```

---

## Quick Start

### 1. Form Request / Controller Validation Rule
Use the built-in `disposable_email` validator:
```php
namespace App\Http\Requests;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest;

class RegisterRequest extends FormRequest
{
    public function rules(): array
    {
        return [
            'name'  => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'email' => ['required', 'string', 'email', 'disposable_email'],
        ];
    }
}
```

Optional modifiers for strict RFC, live DNS MX lookup, and homoglyph spoofing:
```php
'email' => ['required', 'disposable_email:rfc,dns,spoof']
```

### 2. Validation Rule Object
```php
use EragLaravelDisposableEmail\Rules\DisposableEmailRule;
use Disposable;

// Using rule instance
$request->validate([
    'email' => ['required', 'email', new DisposableEmailRule()],
]);

// Or using facade helper
$request->validate([
    'email' => ['required', 'email', Disposable::rule()],
]);
```

### 3. Facade Verification
Check emails programmatically in jobs, webhooks, or services:
```php
use EragLaravelDisposableEmail\Facades\Disposable;

// Returns boolean (true if disposable)
if (Disposable::email($user->email)) {
    logger()->warning("Disposable email attempt: {$user->email}");
}

// Inspect comprehensive result object
$result = Disposable::check($user->email);
$isDisposable = $result->isDisposable();
$matchedDomain = $result->domain();
$dnsValid = $result->hasValidMx();
```

### 4. Blade Directives
```blade
@disposableEmail($user->email)
    <div class="alert alert-warning">
        Please update your email address. Disposable addresses are not permitted.
    </div>
@else
    <div class="badge badge-success">Verified Email</div>
@enddisposableEmail
```
